title: GitHub read adapter and Issue plan drafting
objective: Use fresh GitHub reads and existing gh auth to inspect repository metadata/taxonomy/templates and produce independent Parent/Sub-issue plans with real dependency and scope analysis.
expected_output: Parent/Sub-issue drafts and true dependency DAG
acceptance_criteria: Existing gh auth is preferred; no additional token is created/stored by default.
Existing labels and templates are reused; proposals do not mutate remote/tracked data without approval.
Drafts separate Parent and Sub-issue fields and include acceptance, dependencies, file overlap, contracts, assumptions.
Only independently implementable/verifiable tasks are separated; no artificial parallelization.
Remote data required for a write is refreshed immediately before that write.
undo_classification: Read-only adapter and local draft generation; preserve project sources and existing templates.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries; auth/permission failures are non-retryable until environment changes.
